Amer Sheeny details the performance optimization of an app that scans and processes photographed documents using LLM-based pipelines.

Moving from gemini-2.5-flash-lite to gemini-3.1-flash-lite roughly halved scan times, addressing persistent 60-second timeouts and handling retry logic, timeout budgets, and input token adjustments.
